hints.title: Harmonic Multiples
hints.text: Instead of checking every pair, count the frequencies of values in nums1.

hints.title: Multiples Iteration
hints.text: For each distinct value val in nums2, let base = val * k. Iterate over multiples base, 2 * base, 3 * base up to max(nums1).

hints.title: Product Contribution
hints.text: Add count(nums2[val]) * freq_nums1[multiple] to total good pairs.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Harmonic series sum bounds the number of multiple lookups.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: O(n * m) pairwise comparison with n, m = 10^5 operations yields 10^10 iterations causing TLE.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash frequency counters trade space for harmonic multiple iteration.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use sieve-like harmonic progression over precomputed frequency maps.
